children.value: > Fact From Story: The lawsuit stems from a 2020 antitrust claim over Google’s dominance in the online search market.

> > Fact From Story: The claim is separate from one filed in January by the Department of Justice, along with eight states including New York, California and Colorado, that aims to “halt Google’s anticompetitive scheme, unwind Google’s monopolistic grip on the market and restore competition to digital advertising.”
> > > Fact From Story: On November 6, Google went to trial with Fortnite maker Epic Games.
> > > Fact From Story: The search engine giant last week settled a separate antitrust lawsuit with dating site Match Group.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Different companies are different entities.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Separate claims indicate multiple claims.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Multiple antitrust suits means there is more than one antitrust suit.
